translations.web: They gave their hand that they would put away their wives; and being guilty, they offered a ram of the flock for their guilt.
translations.bsb: They pledged to send their wives away, and for their guilt they presented a ram from the flock as a guilt offering.
translations.kjv: And they gave their hands that they would put away their wives; and being guilty, they offered a ram of the flock for their trespass.
